title: Netflix Reveals the Staggering Price of Its AI Deal With Ben Affleck
description: The streaming service paid $587 million to acquire InterPositive, the AI platform developed by the actor to help filmmakers solve postproduction challenges at a fraction of the cost of reshoots.
